settings.question: How long until I see results?
settings.answer: Most people notice a visible glow and softer skin within 2 weeks. Full results — smoother texture and deeper hydration — appear at 4–8 weeks of daily use.

settings.question: What if it doesn't work for me?
settings.answer: You're covered by our 30-day glow guarantee. If you're not in love, email us within 30 days of delivery for a full refund — even on opened products. Zero risk.

settings.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes. Our formulas are fragrance-free, non-comedogenic and dermatologist tested. We still recommend a quick patch test before first use.

settings.question: Are your products cruelty-free and vegan?
settings.answer: Always. LUMA is 100% vegan and never tested on animals — at any stage.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Shipping is free on all orders over $50. Orders under $50 ship at a flat $4.95. Express options are available at checkout.

settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed in 1–2 business days. Standard delivery then takes 3–6 business days; express 1–3 business days. You'll get a tracking link by email.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship worldwide. International orders usually arrive within 7–14 business days.

settings.question: How do I use my products?
settings.answer: Apply to clean skin morning and night, lightest texture first. A little goes a long way — 2–3 drops or a pea-sized amount is plenty.
